title: Alimentación R08 recovery
human_intent: Recover Prometeo Alimentación as a low-maintenance, mobile-first food-decision surface: recover its product philosophy, interaction lineage, latest known demo state, bugs/rejections and public rules; continue materially where evidence supports it; persist enough sanitized evidence for future agents without publishing private personal food, health or LOCAL data.
authority_boundary: This workstream is recovery/lab coordination only. It does not grant Current, Human Accepted or Served authority and may not mutate those owners unless a later explicit authority process does so.
already_decided: The product began as a deliberately low-maintenance 'Comer' layer centered on deciding what to eat now and what to buy, not on maintaining a detailed pantry/inventory database.
A recovered early direction used three compact surfaces: HOY / RECETAS / COMPRAR; a missing ingredient should lead to an alternative rather than force inventory maintenance.

Conversation history identifies PROMETEO_ALIMENTACION_MOBILE_V01.html as a mobile prototype and PROMETEO_ALIMENTACION_MINIMAL_V02.html as a later minimal prototype, but their exact bytes are not currently present in Current, Catalog, Lineage, the default Git tree or the searched Library; treat those filenames as historical evidence, not recovered artifacts.
Recovered V11 product history describes Hoy/Compras modes, a vertical food roller, center-selection add behavior, compact nutrient bars, categorized shopping toggles and localStorage persistence.

Recovered V12.1 history removes the bottom Hoy/Compras window/bar, moves navigation to horizontal swipe, changes category expansion to a compact down-chevron affordance and repairs cramped shadow spacing.
Recovered V12.2 history moves the color control to the upper-right and allows the selector gesture in both vertical and horizontal directions.
No recovered evidence grants any Alimentación version Human Accepted, Current or Served status.
The exact latest demo bytes are currently CHAT_ONLY_UNKNOWN; a reconstructed candidate must never be mislabeled as the old latest demo.
R08 recovery is complete for available evidence at branch head b2a67ae0bc0e68306e7163775dc98fb536e509ef; no product promotion is implied.
must_preserve: Low maintenance beats exhaustive tracking; the user should not have to keep stock continuously synchronized.
Mobile-first and touch-first interaction is required, while remaining usable with mouse on desktop.
The primary experience is a fast food/meal decision surface plus a simple buying list, not a nutrition dashboard or form workflow.
Nutrient indicators are compact comparative UI feedback, not medical advice and not a substitute for a canonical health record.
Shopping-state persistence may be local, but personal values must remain private/local and never be embedded in public coordination artifacts.
Controls should provide immediate tactile/visual feedback for real state changes and avoid explanatory clutter.
Recovered version history remains evidence with explicit provenance; version numbers alone do not establish product authority.
negative_knowledge: Do not require continuous pantry/stock maintenance as the core interaction.
Do not turn the surface into a generic dashboard full of cards, badges, explanatory copy or KPIs.
Do not add a persistent bottom mobile menu merely to switch between the two primary modes.
Do not duplicate the same choice into rigid separate meal-time forms when one flexible selection interaction can represent the decision.
Do not make nutrient bars dominate the viewport or become a false precision health score.
Do not let mobile panels overlap, hide controls or create an unusable fixed lower sheet.
Do not publish personal food lists, consumption history, health context or other LOCAL payloads into Git coordination/recovery files.
Do not infer Current, Human Accepted or Served from a remembered filename or a higher version number.
high_value_targets: Preserve the completed sanitized recovery ledger as the restart point for future work.
If authentic historical bytes appear later, compare them against the recovered version matrix without silently overwriting provenance.
If adoption is requested later, evaluate the reconstructed candidate through the normal Current/Human Acceptance/Served authority process rather than promoting it from recovery metadata.
known_failures: Assuming a remembered chat attachment still exists as durable Git evidence.
Treating the newest remembered version as accepted or served.
Preserving private personalized food content in a public recovery artifact.
Replacing a low-maintenance chooser with a high-maintenance tracker.
Solving mobile layout by adding more persistent chrome instead of simplifying interaction.
Treating a branch canary gh-pages publication race as evidence that R08 compilation/product recovery failed.
execution_frontier: Recovery is complete for available evidence. Continue only on new authentic historical evidence or a new explicit product-adoption request; do not regenerate the recovery or promote the reconstructed candidate by inference.
